query: What sample size is needed to detect small-to-moderate DIF (effect ~0.2–0.3) between DOAC and LMWH groups for a 20–30 item scale using IRT and multiple‑group CFA?

response.query: What sample size is needed to detect small-to-moderate DIF (effect ~0.2–0.3) between DOAC and LMWH groups for a 20–30 item scale using IRT and multiple‑group CFA?
response.answer: To detect small-to-moderate DIF with an effect size of ~0.2–0.3 on a 20–30 item scale using IRT and multiple-group CFA, a sample size of at least 500 participants per group is typically required.

results.title: Testing Differential Item Functioning in Small Samples - PubMed
results.content: Differential item functioning (DIF) is a pernicious statistical issue that can mask true group differences on a target latent construct.
